Best tips for a new college student?

Get involved. Find a club/sport or two that you can really sink your teeth into. Depending on your chosen school, Greek life may or may not matter. It didn't where I went. Either way, find something that you enjoy and can take a leadership role in at some point.

You mentioned in your OP but I will reiterate--don't skip class. It's really lame when you don't go to class and are begging your classmates for study help. Go to class, and do the work. Everything in high school is planned out, down to the day, and handed to you on a platter. That is not how college works. You are responsible for all of your own shit. You aren't going to get "in trouble" if you don't do your homework. Your parents and your teachers aren't going to nag you. But your professors won't hesitate to fail you at the end of the semester.

If you wouldn't want a future employer to see it, don't post it on social media. This was less of an issue for me (I was in college when facebook was still www.thefacebook.com and you could only sign up with a .edu email address.. I'm old). But it matters. Google yourself often and make sure you like what you see and what you see is the impression you'd want others to have of you.

The scholarship search hasn't ended. There are often departmental scholarships/fellowships available to students if you exceed in your major. Free money is awesome.

If you're so hungover you want to die but you have class, at least take a shower and put something else on besides sweatpants. You don't have to be that obvious.

Take advantage of summer internship opportunities. This is that "work experience" employers want when you graduate with "no experience." Plus, it's a great way to network in your field and start making valuable connections.

Learn how to operate a washer, dryer and microwave before you arrive to campus. I had to teach my freshman roommate how to clean the lint filter, and someone in our building tried to microwave pizza for ten minutes. That is how you burn buildings down. Don't do that.

Speaking of fires, don't be that guy who pulls the fire alarm at 3am because "lol it's just a prank bro!"

Bring flip flops to wear in the shower. Warts are no laughing matter.

Condoms. Every Single Time. Seriously. Most campus health centers give them out for free. If you're with someone who doesn't want to use one, run. Run like Forrest.

Beware the freshman 15. It's really really easy to go home for Christmas after one semester at college and wonder why none of your clothes fit right. Binge drinking and constant access to food via the dining hall is a recipe for instant fat. Take care of yourself. It's easier to not get fat than it is to lose weight.

Live on campus. Immerse yourself. Don't miss out on memories by traveling home every weekend.
